'''Cedarik Killesa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] who served as a member of [[House Killesa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Cedarik Killesa was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who opposed the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and its backing of [[House of Thul|House Thul]], whom he viewed as a puppet. He sent his troops against House Thul on multiple fronts as a diversionary tactic, a ruse which [[Jorad Sindarus Thul]] fell for. While House Thul's forces were spread thin, Killesa led a sizeable force through the siege tunnel that connected the lands of House Thul and [[House Killesa]], a remnant from a more peaceful time. With information gathered on the battlefield, an Imperial allied individual took a set of [[Thermite/Legends|thermite]] charges to collapse the tunnel before it was too late.<ref name="Traitor" />

When confronted, Killesa was furious at the Empire's involvement, which he saw as House Thul's weakness, as well as [[Treason/Legends|treason]]. Even so, he demanded that the individual engage him in an honorable duel instead of detonating the thermite. The spacer refused and detonated the explosives, killing Killesa and his men, forcing the house to resume their ties to House Thul.<ref name="Traitor" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cedarik Killesa is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Troy Hall]].<ref name="Traitor" />
